description: Develop pi-web and the pi extension repos of this project (pi-sync, pi-projects, pi-background, pi-keepalive, pi-mounts, pi-secret-broker, pi-summarize, pi-worktree-include): work in a worktree, run the repo's tests, push agent/<name> (in pi-web, feature/<name> also deploys preview), open a PR and merge it with `gh pr merge --auto --squash` once CI passes. Merging pi-web or pi-sync deploys production. Check a pi-web deploy with its publish-image run (`gh run watch`): it passes only once preview, or production, serves the commit. Read cluster state (pods, events, logs — view-only RBAC, no Secrets) with the kubectl-view action (in a web sandbox: plain kubectl, Prometheus, Loki). Changes under .pi/, .github/ and deploy paths wait for Bryan.

kubectl-view.description: read-only kubectl (infra-k3s-view, cluster-wide view-only RBAC, no Secrets): get, describe, logs, top. One target, e.g. pods, events, deploy/pi-ez-web
